{{Conjecture|legends}}
According to the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Klikk]], the '''owner''' of an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] lost control of the [[Unidentified RX-series pilot droid (Naboo)|unit]] while on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Just as the droid's owner had stepped down from a starship [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] took off in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] [[Naboo system observation post|observation post]] employed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to stop the wayward [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]], but it managed to jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], on course to the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="SGD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
